description: vivePDF UI terminology. Each term maps the English product word to the preferred term per locale, grounded in Adobe Acrobat / Microsoft terminology and the existing catalogue. Terms with check=true are enforced by src/locales/glossary.test.ts: when the English string matches enPattern, the locale string must contain one of the match stems (or the translation).
normalization: Case-insensitive, NFC, Arabic diacritics and tatweel stripped, Russian ё treated as е, {{placeholders}} and {tokens} removed from English before matching.

register.ar: Modern Standard Arabic, imperative singular for actions, Arabic punctuation (، ؛ ؟), Western digits.
register.es: usted; buttons as infinitives (Eliminar páginas); descriptions in third person or usted imperative, never tú.
register.fr: vous; buttons as infinitives; typographic apostrophe and narrow space before ; : ? ! accepted as in catalogue.
register.it: tu (Microsoft Italian style); buttons as imperatives (Elimina pagine).
register.ja: です・ます調; full-width punctuation 。、（）：; no space between Japanese and Latin words except around placeholders as already used.
register.ko: 합니다 for statements, 하세요 for instructions (Microsoft Korean style), no 해요 endings; buttons as noun phrases (페이지 삭제).
register.ru: вы, capitalised only at sentence start; prefer impersonal phrasing; buttons as infinitives (Удалить страницы); ё optional.
register.zh-CN: 你 (Microsoft Simplified Chinese style), never 您; full-width punctuation ，。；：（）！？; half-width space between Chinese and Latin/digits only where the catalogue already does so.

terms.note: Permanent removal of content; not the same as hiding or editing.
Annotation-style rubber stamp. In ar and es the stamp and seal words share a root; context disambiguates.
PDF annotation objects. Acrobat uses the comment word for most of them, so both are accepted.
Fillable PDF form (AcroForm). Not a layout shape.
Digital signature and drawn signature; de accepts Unterschrift for the drawn one.
vivePDF seal = certificate encryption for named recipients, not an electronic seal signature.
Burn annotations/form fields into page content. Acrobat terms: de reduzieren, ja フラット化, zh-CN 拼合, ru сведение.
Running a tool over many files at once; in the scan tool it also means a stack of scanned sheets.
A saved sequence of tools run one after another (like an Acrobat Action).
